title: 初始化代码骨架与真实依赖锁

AC49.claim: A minimal Tauri 2 + React/TypeScript application and real npm/Cargo locks compile locally; native window interaction, WebView2 behavior and installer evidence remain UNVERIFIED.

AC55.claim: The desktop shell has explicit tauri-dev/tauri-build commands while P0 probe build and contract commands remain unchanged and independently addressable.

AC60.claim: T05 files, commands, lock provenance, acceptance mapping, limits and rollback scope are traceable.

scope_limits: No typed IPC, Supervisor, note CRUD, real vault, installer, signing or production command is implemented.
No native GUI interaction, hosted CI or cross-platform runtime result is inferred from local compilation.
Generated node_modules, dist, Tauri gen schemas and target artifacts remain ignored/untracked.
rollback: Remove apps/bmdock-desktop and its workspace/justfile/lockfile additions; preserve crates/bmdock-probe and just contract* semantics.
